'''Yim Neher''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] individual who was active in the twilight [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="aotc exp vd">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Ultimate Illustrated Guide]]''</ref> Neher was present in the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooinian]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] came to see the local [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] named [[Watto/Legends|Watto]].<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref>
